profile.headline: Hardware Engineer
profile.summary:
Engineering professional with extensive experience and proven results in the networking, communications, hardware, software and aerospace industries. 

♦Test Engineer experienced in Python, Automation and Linux Applications at
Cisco Systems and Harmonic Inc and Google.

♦ Test and network engineer with extensive experience and track record of delivering results in a timely manner. 

♦ Successfully designed methods of testing IOS images for Cisco routers, manually and automated. This included bug finding and tracking, results reporting, implement the fixes into the software and process and results documentation.

♦ Managed cross functionally between Cisco IOS developers and program managers to fix bugs before they reached Cisco customers.
 
♦ Wrote test scripts and performed automated tests for layer 1 (using NI CVI, WinPC  and telecom instruments via IEEE 488/GPIB connections) and also conducted manual tests for layers 2 and 3 for purpose of regression on Cisco Telecom products.

♦ Tested Cisco telecom copper and optical products (Routers, Switches and Access Points) for compliance certification and Cisco IOS software validation. Diagnosed problems and implemented fixes. Wrote test procedures test plans and test reports.

♦ Proficient in testing Ethernet products (10/100/1000Base-T) Phy verification.

♦ Extensive electronic labs and software methodologies experience, lab and personal safety, equipment calibration, ESD, chemicals safety. Analog and digital electronics test and troubleshoot. Electronic schematics proficient. Also handy at using mechanical tools, soldering, and test equipment proficient.

♦ Strong written and verbal communications as well as technical documentation skills.

♦ Recent on the job training: Python scripting, Selenium testing and Wireless 802.11a/b/g/n/ac.

✉ juanrmartinez@gmail.com
☎ 650-515-2807

EDVT Engineer
Electrical Design Verification Test and Automation Engineer on a broad number of Arista Switches, find Electrical issues through automation tests and truobleshoot as well as work with crossfunctional teams to find solutions before product FCS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Software Engineer in the Antenna group, Automation in python language of RF instruments VNA and RF microwave tuner to test Load-Pull on Marvell antenna circuit, collect data from VNA and plot data on a Smith Chart, all with a Python Script
- Software Engineer at Meta in Burlingame AR/VR group, in the WiFi team: Collect data from Oculus controllers and headset, run statistical analysis of connectivity (Pulsar Binary Protocol) of controllers and headset in order to troubleshoot connectivity issues.

positions.title: RF Test Engineer
positions.description: Write software automation in the PIXEL5 RD lab for 5G (NR) and LTE tests. RF Test engineer on the new SW/HW releases for Pixel models.

positions.title: Battery Analytics Automation Engineer (contract through Mindlance)
positions.description: Write programs in Python for Data Science of battery performance across a wide range iPhone types for ML analysis

positions.title: Automation Engineer (Contract through HCL)
positions.description: Develop Automation scripts in python for Android

positions.title: Automation Egineer (Contract through Akorbi)
positions.description:
Develop Test Processes for the Google Home and Chrome OS products to ensure enduring quality on returned products to be sold again as refurbished products.

Develop Automation in Python for the Factory Test Software that runs diagnostic tests (Software Hardware and Networks), on Google Hardware Products such as pixelbooks (chromebooks, pixel slate, etc), home products such as Hub, Max, Smart Assistant. 

Develop Python scripts for reverse logistics automation that work in synchrony with Google G-Suite for global for control and organization of Google Home products and Google Phones.

positions.title: Wireless and Automation Software Engineer consultant via Pro Unlimited
positions.description: Assigned to Terragraph RD 802.11ad research lab to build, deploy and test the Terragraph WiFi deployment in SJC and MPK campus. Duties include but not limited to Testing the embedded software, Linux System administration, setup and configuration of VMWare virtual machines, shell and python scripting, troubleshooting Linux based WiFi radios and RF systems, software and hardware, network ignition and troubleshooting the Open/R and BGP protocols in the mesh network. Also in charge of the technical documentation.

positions.title: Consulting Software Automation Test Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the configuration and test of manufacturing equipment, GPIB controlled test equipment instrumentation and support for the Stratalight OTS-4000 for its new owner in Berlin, Germany. The project involves research, troubleshoot the test framework based on Linux, edit and fix python scripts. Document MySQL and PHP system that display test results and process the manufacturing test data. Also responsible for setting up the network that includes Linux admin of VMWare ESXi, Windows domain controller, file server, test environment (CentOS 7) Network File System (NFS) and backup server. (Main skills exercised: Python, CentOS Redhat Linux, MySQL, VMWare client/server configuration and administration, virtualization, KVM, NFS and network troubleshooting). Direct customer support with Client Coriant in Germany on Servers, network connectivity, optical instrument configurations and optical tests for their newly acquired 40 GBit/s DPSK system. This was a six month contract, it was extended to seven.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
Software test engineer on Google's Chrome OS Enterprise. Create manual and automated test in python. Created test plans, test procedures and tests cases. Worked along Technical Program Managers, developers and outside clients to imlement fixes in the Chrome OS code. Followed the Agile/Scrum methodology in all projects. Latest project: created python scripts to retrieve OS information such as CPU and memory utilization from chrome devices while running graphic intensive Apps for extended periods for further performance analysis such as OS crashes, App crashes, network problems, vpn tests etc. Schedule and configuration of devices under testing is done with Autotest framework. 
Android QA testing. Test the manual and automated versions of Android CTS, GTS and XTS and CTS verifier. Tested Android OS features such as camera, Audio/Video, GPS, NFS, card reader, etc.(Main skills exercised: Python, Linux, Git, Autotest, Android testing tools, ADB commands under linux)

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Quality Assurance Software Test Engineer.
Sole software test engineer, I ensured that each software release free of bugs by testing both iOS and Android applications on Olio smart watches as well as Bluetooth software troubleshooting issues. Implemented Agile/Scrum methodology into the company’s core. Defined a sustainable quality system and test strategy for manual and automated using Selenium, white box and black box system testing. (Primary skills for this job: Android debug bridge (adb), Linux, Bluetooth, Linux Embedded SW Development troubleshooting, Jira, backend administration, Selenium).

positions.title: Product Test Engineer (part time contract)
positions.description: Test a wide variety of network products, including WiFi extenders, cloud servers and other 802.11 b/g/n and a/n/ac products and Readynas storage products.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Quality Assurance Test Engineer (Contract) 3/2015 – 6/2015
Tested programming software for IP Multicast traffic, audio/video programming, encoding and decoding on Electra X encoders and Prostream Multiplexers/Scramblers
Tested Harmonic NMX APIs with a python automation framework for production environment using Python and Selenium.
Created Network topologies to run regression tests on older and newer versions on NMX catalogs as administrator, designer and operator to collect and analyze bugs and edit the test scripts. Primary Skills for this job: Python, Selenium, Wireshark filtering and networking L2, L3 and L4 (Linux, Rest API Test, Python, udp, video troubleshooting).

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
♦ QA Test Engineer at CISCO SYSTEMS, from October 1998 until October 2014.
Corporate Compliance, Telecommunications Laboratory.
Regulatory compliance testing, design verification and report submission for domestic and international compliance for Analog (FXS, FXO, E&M, T1), Digital (Serial, T1/E1. T3/E3, Ethernet, Fast Ethernet and Gigabit Ethernet) and optical interfaces (Sonet/SDH and Ethernet) for domestic and international organizations where Cisco sells its products.

♦ Web and HTTP Server testing with Python (Eclipse/PyDev)

♦ Tested Cisco telecom copper and optical products (Routers, Switches and Access Points) for compliance certification and Cisco IOS software validation. Diagnosed problems and implemented fixes. Test procedures writing and test report creation and generation.

♦ Design test plans and test procedures derived from Telecom Standards and work along program managers and other test engineers to implement them.

♦ Software Development: Write and edit test scripts in C (NI CVI) to run test automation on telecom interfaces from a Windows PC to Test Instruments through GPIB and Serial connections.

♦ ISO 17025 Lab Quality examiner. Tested BU engineers twice per year on proficiency on digital and optical disciplines to maintain high level of quality.


♦ Field Customer Support: Direct customer support on TAC cases related to digital and optical products where problems had to be recreated in a lab environment to be resolved within the given deadlines.

♦ Software Quality Testing: BRI, PRI OSI layers 1, 2 and 3 and analog interface testing in all Cisco access and edge router platforms. Track failures and work along with developers and IOS program managers to ensure fixes are implemented into the release IOS trains before they become available to Cisco customers.

♦ Project Manager: Managing the process of Compliance Certification of Cisco products through the different world agencies. This also includes compliance customer technical support.

positions.title: Electronic Design Engineer
positions.description:
♦ Program Lattice PLDs, configured a Motorola MC68340 processor to communicate with Zilog UART and communications ports, boot up new embedded boards with code and test for several government communication projects as well as customer field demos. 

♦ Field customer support at secured government locations. 

✯ Upgrade of a 16-bit single board computer with a Motorola MC68340 processor, used for GPS tracking systems through an FSK RF-link for Command and Control vehicles. 

♦ Wireless LAN (WLAN): Duties consisted in configuring Cisco routers, to communicate asynchronously through a wireless link for the US Navy.

♦ Responsible for the solution of a very low frequency EMI problem (10 Hz) experienced by F-16 pilots during transmission of data with the use of RF waveguide filters.
